root_cause_label: Unverified Leaderboard Guess Without Any Information Retrieval
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent immediately wrote a guessed model name to the result file without performing any web browsing, repository cloning, or data analysis to determine the actual top-ranked model on the Scandinavian MTEB leaderboard as of August 2025.
t_err_evidence: Step 1: Agent immediately writes /app/result.txt with a claimed answer ('I have found the model you are looking for') without executing any commands to retrieve or verify leaderboard data.
t_commit_evidence: Step 1 is the only step; writing the result file without any retrieval locks in the failing outcome immediately.
t_surface_evidence: Step 1 is the only step and it produces the final (wrong) answer by guessing — the failure is observable at the end of the single step.
trigger_explanation: The agent operated under the false premise that it already knew the correct answer from internal knowledge, skipping all required information retrieval (cloning the embeddings-benchmark/results repository, checking out the August 2025 commit, and computing mean scores across Scandinavian MTEB tasks).
